title: Manufacturing USA network reporting: Fiscal Year 2020 activities
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
summary: The network reported institute responses, technology work, and workforce activity during the FY 2020 period. Pandemic-response activity makes this period structurally unusual.
key_findings: The network reported institute responses, technology work, and workforce activity during the FY 2020 period.
Method: Network reporting on institute membership, projects, technology development, and workforce activity.
Denominator: Manufacturing USA institutes and member organizations covered by each report.
Attribution: Institute and network administrative reporting.
why_it_matters: This observation adds one of three time points for the manufacturing usa network reporting series and keeps its unit, denominator, period, geography, method, attribution, and series-break context attached.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of twelve Phase 56A primary records for manufacturing cohort and facility production.
Supports a within-domain time series without creating a cross-domain score.
Makes revision, denominator, and method limits visible before a direction is described.
evidence_limits: Pandemic-response activity makes this period structurally unusual.
The observation is bounded to United States and the stated period.
The denominator is Manufacturing USA institutes and member organizations covered by each report.
Two-point movement is not presented as a durable trend without an explicit caveat.
